name: Bairrind

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bairrind is an Irish mythological being. She was one of the women who traveled to Ireland with Cesair. Cesair fled the biblical Flood and arrived before the waters covered the earth. Three men sailed with the fifty women. In the Book of Invasions, Bith took Bairrind as his primary bride. So paired, Bith and Bairrind echoed the better-known trio of the goddesses Banba, Fódla, and Ériu.

okr.objective: Describe Bairrind, the companion of Cesair and wife of the early invader Bith.
